knownIssues.symptom: Rarely on a cold load: React #418 (hydration) followed by TypeError 'reading parentNode' in the inline $RS script.
knownIssues.rate: public /managers mobile-390 cold loads: about 1 in 10 (1/10, 2/10, 0/12, 4/30 in separate batches); /squads 0/10; desktop /managers 0/12; local next start 0/40 (also with throttling); local next dev 0/25
knownIssues.analysis: DOM-removal trace from document start: in failing loads the async bootstrap scripts ran about 25-35 ms after navigation, while the document was still loading, and React immediately client-rendered the whole root (head meta/title and every body child, including the hidden streaming segments S:0/S:1). The later $RS then finds its placeholder gone. In passing loads the shell hydrates without removals and the segments are swapped in at about 0.9-1.5 s. The HTML order ($RS before $RC) is correct and metadata streaming is not the cause (checked with htmlLimitedBots; the content segment still streams).
knownIssues.impact: React recovers by client rendering; all functional black-box steps pass (568/568). No data or security impact.
knownIssues.decision: No code change: the race is inside Next 15.5 streaming/bootstrap with its vendored React. Re-check after the next Next.js upgrade. The F-060 note attributing the /best-xi #418 to deployment skew is superseded by this analysis.
